defects: CO-RUNNER COUPLING, still live -- this is the defect that was fixed in geometry_vendi_score and geometry_isoscore on the SAME DAY and was not fixed here. geometry_magnitude is not in core.py's cache_hidden_tasks, its effective use_cache is True, and it has NO cache-size refusal, so it consumes whatever cache the other tasks happened to build. Same model, same magnitude config, only the co-runner's num_samples changed: magnitude_area 4.894277 (alone) / 5.298013 (+lid 50) / 5.689075 (+lid 200) / 5.451367 (+lid 1000) -- a 16.2% spread; magnitude_low_scale 5.801774 / 5.774101 / 6.373508 / 6.518469 (12.9%); magnitude_median_scale 0.160174 / 0.165035 / 0.167948 / 0.164164; _meta_magnitude_area_norm 0.381534 / 0.389036 / 0.403387 / 0.404555 (6.0%).

The two collection routes are DIFFERENT PROTOCOLS, the exact defect fixed in geometry_isoscore. The cache route takes cache.get_hidden_states(per_sample=False) -- every token of every cached document -- while the fallback calls collect_hidden_states without max_tokens_per_doc, so the code default of 10 TOKENS PER DOCUMENT applies: 100 documents give ~1000 candidate tokens instead of ~13,000. The 100-point subsample is then drawn from populations that differ by an order of magnitude, which is most of the 16.2% spread above.

The scale family is not scale-invariant, and the task emits no promoted invariant summary. Measured on one fixed geometry rescaled by 1e-3..1e3: magnitude_med_scale 1.182990 / 4.154613 / 35.164450 / 99.884793 / 100.000000, magnitude_dimension 1.010002 / 2.248102 / 2.199745 / 2.092448 / 0.002249, magnitude_auc 1.561068 / 9.112523 / 14.053750 / 18.311955 / 21.207296. This is INHERITED FROM magnipy (t_med scales as 1/sqrt(s) while magnitude is covariant as Mag_{sX}(t) = Mag_X(st)), so it is faithfulness, not a BLME bug -- but it means every scale-family column is partly a measure of activation norm.

num_samples = 100 points is the whole estimand (the O(n^3) inverse bounds it), and no seed sweep or standard error is emitted, so the reader cannot separate a between-model difference from subsample noise.
fix: Give geometry_magnitude the same undersized-cache refusal geometry_vendi_score and geometry_isoscore now have (self-collect unless the cache holds >= num_samples documents), and pass max_tokens_per_doc=None in the fallback so both routes are the same protocol. Then re-collect: every archived magnitude value depends on which tasks co-ran.
